scope: Read-only review of first behavior creation parameter scalar/source proposal module. No repository mutation or version change.

findings.summary: apply derives a general JSON CST even after the behavior inspector has already rejected oversized source, so the 32KiB manifest budget does not guard JSON.parse work.
findings.reproduction: 32769-character and1MiB valid planner manifest plus whitespace each cause one full-size JSON.parse call before the expected rejection.
findings.acceptanceBoundary: Neither invalid source is accepted; ordinary UI planner products are already bounded. This finding does not establish a GUI exploit, persistent data loss or privilege change.
findings.minimalFix: Validate string/character bound before inspector and derive the CST only after recognized/ok checks pass.
findings.minimalRegression: With JSON.parse counter restored in finally, assert no oversized source parse for32769-character input; retain valid small source merging and final total-byte rejection tests.
